capabilities: Pin files or folders above their unpinned siblings within the same folder
Pin items to a compact shelf at the top of the File Explorer
Unpin or switch pin modes by clicking pin controls or context menus
Run pin, unpin, toggle, and clear-all commands from the command palette
Configure or hide inline pin controls, the shelf, and original tree rows in settings
extras: Relies on non-public File Explorer APIs; if Obsidian changes the relevant scroller or sorting methods, shelf and row-ordering integrations may break while commands and saved state survive. Makes no network requests and stores only settings and pinned paths.
problem: Obsidian's File Explorer sorts items alphabetically, so important files and folders drift down the list with no way to keep them at top.

relations.evidence: When Nicons is enabled, Pinup uses its Phosphor push-pin shape through an isolated SVG copy.

summary: File Explorer pinning plugin that sorts pinned files and folders above siblings or lists them on a compact shelf above the vault tree.
